title: Scheduled restricted Fourier estimator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\leq\tfrac12$ and $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$. The scheduled estimator is the membership-query program for estimating the restricted Fourier weight using the sample count prescribed by $\varepsilon$ and $\delta$.
caveat: The sample-count function is not included in the supplied definitions, so its precise dependence on the parameters cannot be stated.
